name: @battuta/plugin-stylus
description: Notes written with the Apple Pencil or the S Pen: tap the staff for a note at the pitch under the pen; hold, and a cross at the tip sets its duration (left, right) and pitch (up, down) before it is written.
//: exports point at src/, NOT a built dist/: Vite and tsc both consume linked TypeScript, so a plugin has no build step and no prepare.

dependencies: @battuta/api and react (the cross renders on the overlays point) and nothing else of the workspace. The pen itself is the host's stylus service (capability "stylus"): native capture lives in the shell, never in a plugin.
